exposure: Low-dose ketamine (0.25 mg/kg) administered during caesarean section
outcome: Degree of depression (Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale)
Numeric rating scale score of pain
finding: Low-dose ketamine administered during caesarean section did not prevent postpartum depression but was associated with reduced pain scores 6 weeks postpartum.
mod_finding: Intra-operative low-dose ketamine (0.25 mg/kg) does not have a preventive effect on postpartum depression.
